Show the difference between break, continue and pass.

Supplied answer
for i in range(1, 6):
    if i == 3:
        break # stop the loop completely
    print(i, end=" ") # 1 2
print()
for i in range(1, 6):
    if i == 3:
        continue # skip only this turn
    print(i, end=" ") # 1 2 4 5
print()
for i in range(1, 6):
    if i == 3:
        pass # does nothing, just a placeholder
    print(i, end=" ") # 1 2 3 4 5
Note: break exits, continue skips one turn, pass is only a filler statement.
